material_updates: Separated stationary global-history off-policy PAC-Bayes from arbitrary-drift local previous-posterior PAC-Bayes rather than treating them as one guarantee.
Derived a deterministic atomic-posterior specialization: pre-supported deterministic configurations can be certified with complexity log(1/P(theta)).
Identified e-detectors as an independently certified routing signal for evidence-memory resets, without transferring detector guarantees into learning guarantees.
Kept vector-valued off-policy inference as a frozen-target reduction candidate because no direct adaptive multivariate off-policy theorem was verified.
exact_next_action: Compare the fixed-prior supermartingale proof of Theorem 3.2 with Appendix C's product-prior martingale line by line to determine whether a predictable prior can coexist with full-history reuse without double counting. Then design the smallest independently monitored e-detector statistic that can route stable/global-history versus drift/local-history evidence while keeping the switch itself outside both learning certificates.
